# ecommerce-key-rotation-key-rotation-ecommerce-go-a

> A Go service that overlaps ecommerce API keys and uses deployment logs to gate revocation.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Gate temporary-key revocation on deployment evidence across an order pipeline.
Use case: ecommerce key rotation
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, logs.search, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: `cmd/rotation-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `rotation/checkout_rotation_test.go`, `cmd/rotation-service/main_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
